question: How much will my regional taxes go up in 2027?
note: The eval runner saved only the final answer, so no steps are shown. Statement kinds weren't saved and are shown as "fact"; every citation was checked again by code when this file was made. The start time is worked out from the report's end time and each case's duration.

event.text: The official documents do not say how much your regional taxes will go up in 2027. The draft 2027 property tax increase is not published until December 16 [1]. Your regional tax may change; in 2026 it rose 5.10 percent, which added $142.18 [2]. The Region also faces an infrastructure renewal shortfall of $87.6 million each year [3]. You can contact the Region of Waterloo Finance Department at 2027PlanAndBudget@regionofwaterloo.ca or Regional Council for more information once the draft is released.
